description: This file defines a generic Page class used for pagination, encapsulating a list of items and the total number of filtered records.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: A generic class representing a page of items with total filtered records for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilteredRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of filtered records.

methods.name: getPageItems
methods.description: Returns the list of items on this page.
